# declick

> Turn anything into a CLI so your agents stop clicking. declick compiles an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, a GraphQL API, an MCP server, a Postman/Insomnia collection, a HAR capture, a SQLite database, a CLI tool's own --help, a browser page, or a native Windows app into a command line tool with one guaranteed output contract, and every declick command honors that contract too.

- Source: https://github.com/ucsandman/declick
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/declick
- Install: npm i -g declick (Node 24 or newer)
- Contract: describe under 500 tokens, --json default when piped, --fields (dotted paths), --limit, --rows, --dry-run, exit codes 0 ok 1 error 2 not found 3 blocked 4 auth, mutating verbs gated by DashClaw (strict by default once DASHCLAW_API_KEY is set), auth by env key name scoped to its adapter's origin, generated SKILL.md per adapter plus one for declick itself
- Engines, all built in with zero runtime dependencies: openapi (OpenAPI 3 and Swagger 2, JSON or YAML), graphql, mcp (stdio and streamable HTTP), postman (Postman v2.1 and Insomnia v4), har, sqlite (tables/views to list/get/insert/update/delete plus query), cli (compiled from a tool's own --help), web (a real browser over CDP; a miss returns page elements, never a screenshot), desktop (native Windows via deskclaw UI Automation, deterministic recipe replay, authoring and repair through a bounded Claude Code session)
- declick engines --source <x> says which engine a source would land on before anything is written

## Commands

- declick add <source> --name <n> [--verbs a,b | --tag t] [--engine e] [--host h] [--url u]   compile any source above into an adapter
- declick run <n> <verb> [args] [--flags]   invoke a verb; also <n> <verb> once ~/.declick/bin is on PATH (declick path --install)
- declick describe <n> [--full] [--verb v] [--grep text] [--offset N]   the surface; --json for data. declick manifest <n> [--schema] for the full compiled contract
- declick list | status [<n>] | doctor | auth <n> | engines [--source x] | version | commands | <cmd> --help   inventory, last run and error, health, missing keys, the whole command surface as data
- declick add app:"Title" --name <n> --goal "..." --verb v   Claude authors a desktop verb (declick desk arm 15 first)
- declick author <n> --goal "..." | repair <n> <verb> | proposals <n> | accept <n> <verb> | recipes <n> | recipe <n> <verb>
- declick build <n> | lint <n> | skill [<n>] | remove <n> [<verb>] | export <n> | import [<file>|-] [--example]
- declick desk windows | tree <window> [--depth N --type T --grep re --interactive] | read <window> <path> [--prop p] | clipboard get|set | arm [minutes] | disarm
- declick web tree <url> [--selector css]   a page as a tree of elements, interactive ones first
- declick audit [--adapter n] [--since t] [--failed]   the run log: what ran, what governance decided
- declick ui [--port N] [--open] [--allow-authoring]   local page with add, build, repair, remove

## Output

- Success: {"ok":true,"data":...,"meta":{"count":N,"truncated":false,"governance":{...}}}   (meta.dryRun: true on --dry-run)
- Failure: {"ok":false,"error":"...","exit":N}   plus "data" when the engine has a payload
- Flags: --flag value and --flag=value; boolean flags never eat the next argument; unknown flags are exit 1
- Adapters live at ~/.declick/<n>/manifest.json; skills at ~/.claude/skills/<n>/SKILL.md; never edit either by hand
